language: "Urdu"

Ya Fatima.. Ya Fatima..

Ya Fatima.. Ya Fatima..

Fatima Fatima Fatima Fatima

Fatima Fatima Fatima Fatima

Fatima Fatima-Fatima Fatima

Har Nabi Hujjat-E-Kibriya Hai

Magar Fatima Fatima Hai!

Zikr Quraan Me Sab Ka Hua Hai

Magar Fatima Fatima Hai !!

Panjtan Ko Bana Kar Khuda Ne Kaha

Hai Mujassam Mashi’at Meri Mustafa

Meri Marzi Ka Malik Ali Murtaza

Meri Qudrat Hussain O Hasan, Fatima

Khalq Paanchon Ko Maine Kiya Hai

Magar Fatima Fatima Hai !!

Tujhpe Khul Jayega Padh Hadees-E-Kisa

Kis Tarah Panjtan Ka Ta’arruf Hua

Rab Sabit Ye Humm Fatima Se Kiya

Ek Hi Zaat Hai Markaz E Innama

Khud Muhammad Bhi Zere Kisa Hai

Magar Fatima Fatima Hai !!

Fatima Fatima Fatima Fatima

Ik Ki Khatir Haram Ko Sajaya Gaya

Ik Ke Hujre Ko Qibla Banaya Gaya

Ik Ke Bete Musalle Pe Aate Rahe

Ik Ko Kaabe Ke Andar Bulaya Gaya

Umme Haider Bhi Ik Fatima Hai

Magar Fatima Fatima Hai !!

Saamra Se Yehi Aa Rahi Hai Sada

Lailatul Qadr Ko Kon Samjhe Bhala

Sare Masoom Hain Hujjat E Kibriya

Hujjaton Pe Hai Hujjat Magar Fatima

Ham Me Har Ik Hijab E Khuda Hai

Magar Fatima Fatima Hai !!

Har Nabi Hujjat-E-Kibriya Hai

Magar Fatima Fatima Hai!!

Main Taqaabul Karun Kab Ye Auqat Hai

Har Haqiqat Haqiqat Ka Asbaat Hai

Sirf Umme Abiha Wo Ik Zaat Hai

Maa Muhammad Ki Hona Badi Baat Hai

Bil Yaqin Amna Amna Hai

Magar Fatima Fatima Hai !!

Aa Gayin Fatima

Aa Gayin Fatima

Jab Raheel E Amin

De Rahe Hain Sada

Aa Gayin Fatima

Aa Gayin Fatima

Aa Gayin Fatima

Aa Gayin Fatima

Aaj Kush Hain Bahut

Ashraf’ul Ambiya

Aa Gayin Fatima

Aa Gayin Fatima

Fatima Fatima Fatima Fatima

Han, Gir Ke Qadmon Pe Shah Ke Wo Kahta Raha

Ae Ghafoor Ur Rahim, Ae Shahe Qarbala

Tera Mujrim Tere Rubaru Aa Gaya

To Shah Ne Seene Se Hurr Ko Laga Kar Kaha

Jurm Tera Bahut Hi Bada Hai

Magar Fatima Fatima Hai !!

Har Nabi Hujjat-E-Kibriya Hai

Magar Fatima Fatima Hai !

Lanatein Kar Rahe Ho Abhi Tak Wusu

Kya Hua Zulm Se Tumko Haasil Husu

Inki Azmat Na Ki Tumne Dil Se Qubool

Zalimon Phir Bhi Baaqi Hai Naam E Batool

Tumne Karna Tha Jo Kar Liya Hai

Magar Fatima Fatima Hai !!

Teri Mutthi Me Baagein Hai Kounain Ki

Tere Haathon Me Nabzein Hain Darain Ki

Kun Tajalli Tere Naam Ke ‘Ain Ki

Teri Mahkoom Madar Hai Hasnain Ki

Ya Ali Tera Rutba Siwa Hai

Magar Fatima Fatima Hai !!

Umr Se Kam Nahin Hoti Azmat Kabhi

Ek Bachhi Se Iski Sanad Hai Mili

Apni Daadi Ki Manind Hai Wo Jari

Kamsini Me Wo Shahi Ulat Kar Rahi

Sin Ba-Zahir Sakina Ka Kya Hai

Magar Fatima Fatima Hai !!

Ya Fatima.. Ya Fatima..

Ya Fatima.. Ya Fatima..

Bole Fizza Se Qambar Zara Ghaur Kar

Mere Maula Me Hain Sab Khuda Ke Hunar

Raat Bhar Mad’h-E-Haider Wo Karta Raha

Wajd Taari Tha Fizza Pe Us Dam Magar

Usne Sab Maan Kar Bhi Kaha Hai

Magar Fatima Fatima Hai !!

Shahanshahi Se Bhi Qeemti Hai

Habsh Ko Chhor Kar Us Se Muh Modkar

Sayeda Ki Ye Jo Fizza Ne Ki Naukari Hai

Shahanshahi Se Bhi Qeemti Hai!!

Dahar Me Dekh Lo Har Jagah Par

Bahot Mashhoor Inki Wafa Hai

Ik Hain Abbas Aur Ik Hain Fizza

Farq Inme Bhala Kon Sa Hai

Mujhse Poocho To Farq Wafa Ka

Ik Hai Chand Aur Ik Chandni Hai !!

Fatima Fatima Fatima Fatima

Lakh Mana Gunehgar Hai Admi

Hai Azadar Ki Haami Bint E Nabi

Fatima Ke Takallum Hain Mana Yehi

Hamko Dozakh Me Jane Na Degi Kabhi

Garche Isyan Se Daman Bhara Hai

Magar Fatima Fatima Hai

Fatima Fatima Fatima Fatima
